column6: Intentional: tenant sets its own price, floor-validated server-side. Not a trust violation -- this is the product's purpose.
Correct -- price comes from the server-side package record, never the client.

finding: Client-supplied claim amount; approval remains a separate super_admin-only step (approve_claim) that independently sets amount_approved -- the requested amount alone has no financial effect until admin approval, consistent with a claims-intake pattern (not itself a fund movement).

OPEN GAP: no authoritative payout-eligible-balance ledger exists anywhere in the codebase to validate this amount against. Not remediated this slice per the mission's canonical rule against inventing payout/withdrawal behavior. See known-limitations.md.
Correct -- new_amount is a server-side lookup, not client-trusted.
